scope: XAUUSD M1 BUY US 08:00-17:00 America/New_York; E_DISPLAY_EPISODE_REACTION_RANK_US_BUY_V1

scientific_interpretation.decision_basis: The immutable historical replication passed every support condition frozen before its outcomes were opened, retained most of the DEV discrimination and top-versus-bottom separation, and reproduced monotone fixed-DEV quartiles without refit.

transport.interpretation: Moderate expected attenuation occurred out of sample, while the Q4 rate remained effectively unchanged and all fixed gates remained positive.

mandatory_semantic_guard.finding: The frozen full score is dominated by zone_width_v.
mandatory_semantic_guard.interpretation: The historical evidence supports prediction of the frozen reaction event, but does not establish that persistence or family add material information beyond zone width, nor that width represents intrinsic market-level strength. Because invalidation is defined below zlo while the favorable threshold is fixed above zhi, wider zones also receive more geometric room before invalidation. This is a claim limitation, not a license to alter the frozen candidate.
forbidden_claims: incremental value of persistence and family

allowed_operations: draft and freeze a complete prospective-confirmation preregistration
implement prospective data-ingestion, append-only hashing, feature-ledger generation, blinding and checkpoint tooling
test prospective tooling only on synthetic fixtures and historical dry-runs whose outcomes are not used to alter the frozen candidate
freeze exact environment, code, data-source, missing-data and revision-handling rules
define the exact first eligible prospective session using the first complete NY session strictly after the final planning-package seal
freeze a single stopping/checkpoint rule and a no-interim-performance-peeking firewall
pre-register an interpretation-only deterministic zone_width_v comparator without refitting or changing the primary candidate
forbidden_operations: generate, read, score or summarize prospective reaction outcomes
use any session whose outcome was knowable before the final planning-package seal as prospective evidence
refit or alter the frozen DEV model
change features, coefficients, intercept, transforms, family vocabulary, rank mapping or fixed quartiles
change contact, arming, favorable, invalidation, ambiguity, horizon or session rules
use the width-only comparator to rescue a failed primary result or to select a new model
authorize production, trading use or Pine modification

mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.population: Same frozen top-3 displayed E episodes in the upper-Z4-conditioned XAUUSD M1 US BUY universe.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.model: Load the canonical frozen DEV model with no refit or recalibration.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.primary_outcome: Unchanged frozen 0.50*v0 favorable-before-invalidation reaction outcome with the same contact-bar and 30-available-bar rules.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.start_rule: The prospective window begins at the 08:00 America/New_York open of the first complete NY session strictly after the final prospective-planning package is sealed. No earlier August 2026 data may be backfilled as prospective evidence.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.single_checkpoint_rule: Open performance once, immediately after the first completed NY session for which both cumulative conditions are met: at least 90 eligible complete-session dates represented and at least 1000 primary contacts. No discretionary delay or extension based on unseen or partially seen performance.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.interim_firewall: Feature/contact counts and data-quality status may be monitored; labels, success rates, AUC, quartile outcomes and any performance proxy must remain inaccessible until the single checkpoint.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.data_provenance: Raw M1 inputs and outcome-free feature snapshots must be captured append-only with acquisition timestamps and SHA-256 manifests under a rule frozen before the first eligible session.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.data_quality: Missing/duplicate/revised M1 rules and any fail-closed data-quality threshold must be explicit before prospective collection begins.
primary_gate: AUC minus 0.5 greater than 0 with session-cluster 95% CI lower bound greater than 0
fixed DEV quartile rates monotone Q1 <= Q2 <= Q3 <= Q4
fixed DEV Q4 minus Q1 greater than 0 with session-cluster 95% CI lower bound greater than 0
fixed DEV Q4 minus Q1 positive in all three contiguous complete-session blocks
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.interpretation_control: Report the deterministic raw-zone-width comparator and paired full-versus-width discrimination as a separately labeled interpretive diagnostic. It cannot alter the primary gate. Absence of incremental full-model value limits the label to a width-dominated reaction rank.
mandatory_prospective_plan_requirements.post_checkpoint: Regardless of result, stop for a new Pro scientific gate. A prospective pass still does not by itself validate trading profitability.
